content.text:
I implemented `slugify` in `src/strings.js` and added five tests for it in `test/strings.test.js`. `npm test` passes all 7 tests, including the two existing `capitalize` ones.

It handles `đ`/`Đ` explicitly, strips the other diacritics, and lowercases. Every run of non-`a-z0-9` characters becomes one hyphen. Leading hyphens are removed first, then the result is cut at 50 characters, then trailing hyphens are removed, so a slug cut at 50 never ends in a hyphen.

The tests cover basic text, Vietnamese diacritics, trimming and collapsing of separators, input with no letters or digits (which gives an empty string), and the 50-character cut.

My first attempt at writing the files failed on a Windows encoding error and emptied `src/strings.js`. I restored it from git and redid the edit, so the final files are correct. I haven't committed anything.
